title: fix(objectql): the duplicate refusal reads in the writer's locale and names a declared composite unique index's fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Fixes #33213

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## Maintainer quick read

- What changes: the 409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` sentence is now composed by the engine in the writer's language from the platform operation-message catalog, and a composite unique index names its fields by label when that can be established.
- Why: a downstream app writing a duplicate of a "Plant + Carbon Grade + Cost Week" unique index under `Accept-Language: zh-CN` got the English "A record with this value already exists" and could not tell which fields collided.
- Risk and rollback: the wire shape is unchanged (`code`, 409 and the meaning of `field` stay), only the `error` text moves; the English single-field and no-field sentences are byte-identical. Rollback is a revert of this PR.
- Read first: `packages/objectql/src/duplicate-record-error.ts` (`declaredCompositeIndex` and `buildEndUserMessage`), `packages/types/src/unique-violation.ts` (new `uniqueViolationColumns`; the two existing functions answer as before), `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts` (three new catalog keys).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-duplicate-record-label-sentence.test.ts`; expect all green, including the zh-CN composite case asserting `已存在「工厂」、「牌号」、「成本周次」均相同的记录`.
- Needed from you: nothing; the seat lands it.

## What changes

- **The sentence is composed where the locale and the schema are.** `DuplicateRecordError` (`@objectstack/objectql`) now renders its end-user sentence from the platform operation-message catalog (`renderOperationMessage`, the catalog `DELETE_RESTRICTED` already renders from) in the write's message context, so a deployment's `errors.duplicate_record*` translation overrides it. It is carried in-process as `endUserMessage`, and the `DUPLICATE_RECORD` arm of `classifyDataError` (`@objectstack/types`) ships it as the 409 body's `error`. That arm holds neither a locale nor a schema, which is why it composed fixed English before.
- **Three catalog keys**, every platform locale (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`): `duplicate_record` (names nothing), `duplicate_record_field` (`{{field}}`, one label), `duplicate_record_fields` (`{{fields}}`, a list spelled by the locale's existing `field_label_quoted` / `field_label_list_separator` rules). The English `duplicate_record` and `duplicate_record_field` are byte-identical to the fixed text the HTTP doors answered, so an English deployment reads no change for one field or none.
- **A composite unique index is named only on a declared match.** `uniqueViolationColumns(error)` (new, `@objectstack/types`) reads the composite key's columns from the SQLite and Postgres texts the existing readers already parse, organization part set aside as `uniqueViolationField` sets it aside. The engine names them only when that set equals the `fields` of a unique index (`'global'` or `'organization'`) the object declares, and the user's sentence names them only when every one has a label (translation, else declared `label`). Anything short of that names nothing: driver text alone cannot tell a `tenancy.tenantField` column from an authored one, and a wrong field name is worse than none. `uniqueViolationColumn` / `uniqueViolationField` answer exactly as before (the shared reader was generalised over a reduction, not changed).
- **The wire shape does not move.** `code` stays `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, the status 409, `field` keeps its single-column contract (absent for a composite), and no key is added. The composite's labels also enter the engine's `message` (relayed as `developerMessage`) and its API names enter the in-process `developerMessage`.
- Why not `userMessage`: that name on a thrown error is the ApiError contract's producer-marked channel, which `withDeclaredUserMessage` promotes to its own wire key. Whether this refusal joins that channel is a contract decision this fix does not make, so the property is `endUserMessage` and the wire is unchanged (pinned: `not.toHaveProperty('userMessage')`).

## Tests

Pins added (zh-CN and en, single-field and multi-field, plus the fallbacks):

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-duplicate-record-label-sentence.test.ts` — new top-level `describe` in the existing harness, through the real write doors (`insert`, `update` by id) and the real `mapDataError`: a declared `unique: 'organization'` index over `plant + carbon_grade + cost_week` named in en (`A record with the same “Plant”, “Carbon Grade”, “Cost Week” already exists`) and zh-CN (`已存在「工厂」、「牌号」、「成本周次」均相同的记录`), the Postgres DETAIL shape, an uncatalogued locale (`de-DE`) falling back to the en sentence, a deployment `errors.duplicate_record_fields` override; five controls that must name nothing (no matching declared index, a non-unique match, no indexes, one unlabelled field, a MySQL index-only refusal), each asserting the unnamed sentence in zh-CN and en; a single unlabelled field in zh-CN. The two existing zh-CN single-field pins now expect `已存在相同客户名称的记录` (they pinned the English sentence around a Chinese label — the reported defect).
- `packages/rest/src/rest-duplicate-record-arm.test.ts` — a real `ObjectQL` on real better-sqlite3 with a declared `'global'` composite index: the exact 409 body in en and zh-CN, no `field`, no value.
- `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.test.ts` — the three keys in every locale with exactly their own placeholder, en byte-identity with the previous wire text, zh-CN / base-language / unknown-locale rendering, the `errors.` override.
- `packages/types/src/unique-violation.test.ts` — `uniqueViolationColumns` on SQLite and Postgres composites, no overlap with `uniqueViolationField`, and `undefined` for index names, expression parts and a NOT NULL refusal.

## Acceptance notes

- **MySQL still names no field, single or composite.** Its duplicate-entry text names an index (`for key 'idx_…'`), never columns; mapping a physical index name to a declared index is the wider schema-lookup contract `uniqueViolationColumn`'s doc already defers. The sentence is still in the writer's locale there.
- **A legacy hand-written global index that lists `organization_id` itself** (`fields: ['organization_id', 'a', 'b']`) matches nothing and gets the unnamed (localized) sentence: the declared side is compared as written. The spec already steers new code to `unique: 'organization'`, which matches.
- **A bare `unique: true` index** (refused at parse since protocol 18, converted on stored rows) is not treated as unique by the matcher. The existing real-driver pin in `rest-duplicate-record-arm.test.ts` §2 registers such an object straight into the registry and keeps its unnamed sentence for that reason; the new real-driver pin declares `'global'`.
- **The raw driver unique arm** further down `classifyDataError` (a unique error that did not pass through the engine envelope) keeps its fixed English sentence: that module holds no locale. Every engine write door wraps first, so the reported path is the envelope.
- The `envelope without endUserMessage` fallback in the arm keeps the previous sentence for an envelope built by an older engine; every envelope this engine builds carries the sentence.
- Locale ladder: like every `renderOperationMessage` refusal, this takes the one `ExecutionContext.locale` value, so a request locale the catalog lacks reads `en`, not the workspace default (the limitation `ApiErrorSchema.userMessage` "Language" already records for the operation refusals).

## Verification

- Local gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 87 families for this diff at af12b055; all 87 run, 80 exit 0. CI runs all of them on a clean build. `--ran` reconciliation: 87 derived, 87 run, 0 unrun.
